content_fields.title: Enable image vulnerability scanning (Docker)
content_fields.description: Scan container images for known vulnerabilities before they are used.
content_fields.guidance: Image scanning should run on every build and on a schedule for images already in the registry, with results gated by severity so a high-severity finding blocks promotion.
content_fields.found: There is no build pipeline and no scanning step; images are built locally.
content_fields.missing: A registry with scanning enabled and a pipeline to gate on the results.
content_fields.conclusion: Scanning is enabled in the registry and pipeline platform rather than in this repository.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should enable registry scanning and define the severity gate.
